lines.text: With a groan, Rapi and Dorothy collapse.
She stands in front of it.
Marian reaches her hand out and places it on the thing's chest.
the thing moves its arm and grabs Marian's arm.
It just stares at Marian with half-closed eyes.
With its body crooked, it shakes.
The large amount of Dark Matter that appeared when the Goddess of Victory Statue collapsed shakes too.
The wriggles and moves toward the thing.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Dark Matter that aided in the Queen's transformation is in trouble.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It's moving on its own to isolate its master and restore her.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She's no longer able to use Liliweiss's body, but the Queen will obtain a new one.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Liliweiss's body was too unknown, which made both reproduction and restoration impossible,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: but now the Queen will get a new body, one made of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Of course, it won't be as strong.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It's so... pathetic. She kept this card up her sleeve until the very last second.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And that is why she will win.
Rapunzel and Nayuta, who had been busy healing, rush over.
The Commander and Andersen stumble to their feet and follow.
Marian moves her Dark Matter and stops the thing from moving.
The thing's Dark Matter flows like a wave, growing closer.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: We have to take the Queen Gene!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: The Queen Gene works the same way as corruption!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: It starts in the core, heads to the brain, and contaminates the NIMPH!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Use Vapaus! I'll use my blood!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The moment thy blood toucheth her, ye will both likely face ruin!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Nay! Young Lady Liliweiss's brain would grow decrepit, and fail in its function!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: She is dependent on her NIMPH; should it vanish, naught but a shell will remain!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: But her NIMPH is contaminated! So what do we do?!
The Dark Matter steadily grows closer.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I can stay corruption by setting NIMPH against NIMPH on a path of mutual ruin.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... Yes. I can use my sisters' NIMPH.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: If I give her this NIMPH and it destroys the Queen Gene,

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: then Lilith can go back to her normal self.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... All my sisters have given their permission.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: They want us to take back our Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: No, Persinette. Use not the maidens' NIMPH given to thee.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... What? But we need enough NIMPH to...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall use the NIMPH of all my scattered clones.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: All of it. None shall remain.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... I have no NIMPH remaining unto myself. No choice is left me but to use theirs.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: But then you won't have any left.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I take pleasure in considering the weight of life.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Compared with the lives of the maidens thou dost carry, our lives are a trifle.
As they fly in the air,
Soon, the air is full of gold.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The endeavor requireth a delicate hand.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou shouldst do it. Thy skill is far superior to mine.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis I who should speak those words to thee.
The golden particles enter the thing's body.
The thing struggles, but Marian doesn't let it go.
Rapunzel and Nayuta place their hands on its head.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: As I forethought, they are entangled most tightly!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Yeah! It's even worse than corruption!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall find the Queen Gene! Persinette, do thou the ruin!
It bursts from the thing's eyes and mouth.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I can't wait to tell Lilith.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: She's going to love hearing how she shot golden beams from her eyes and mouth.
Golden light bursts from the thing's whole body.
Marian feels the resistance against her Dark Matter decrease.
The approaching Dark Matter suddenly picks up speed.
In an instant, it swallows Liliweiss.
Marian hastily moves her Dark Matter to stop the wave trying to swallow up Lilith.
However, she's pushed back too far by the tide. Marian is reaching her limit.
Rapunzel's halo gleams. Her staff vibrates.
She pounds wildly at the Dark Matter covering Lilith.
But the resistance is too strong. She can't stop it.
He sees the smile he once knew.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Don't make that face, like you're just happy to see me one last time!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Heh, you've always been able to read me so well.
The black wall closes. Liliweiss is no longer visible.
More and more layers close over her.
He pounds wildly at the black wall.
His skin scrapes off, leaving bloody trails. But he doesn't stop.
Vapaus kills nanomachines! With my blood...!
No! Are you planning to meet the person you love looking like a bloody mess?
The Commander keeps pounding his fists.
His hands and arms are a mess. But he doesn't stop.
Everyone stares at him in a daze.
The Dark Matter wall boils in response.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Heh... You lunatic. Just call me Andersen from now on.
Andersen adjusts his tie and straightens his clothes.
and then throws himself into the dark hole.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I've had dozens of opportunities to get married.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Do you have any idea how many girls threw themselves at me in the Ark?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I've got status, skill, a hot body. They just wouldn't leave me alone.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Everyone around me kept trying to set me up on dates too.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: You're the only one for me.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: From the moment I saw you, I knew it had to be you.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I think you forgot to add something. The most important part.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I don't want to say it here. I can't imagine anywhere less romantic.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Let's get out of here. I know an amazing place.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Because I'll become that thing again.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: The Queen will take over my head.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I thought you were all better now.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It planted the Queen Gene everywhere.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It's creeping up inside of me.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It's going to take over again soon.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: In other words, I'm still the Queen.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: The Queen will take control more stubbornly and thoroughly than before.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I need you to listen to me. Tell the girls, tell everyone.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I have some habits when I fight. When I swing my fist, I leave my waist on the opposite side open for a moment.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: And I'm not good at running, so I'll reflexively jump. It's an advantage to control the air.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Also, I get distracted easily in the middle of a fight, so I lose the ability to distinguish what's a decoy.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Spread out and distract me. Then...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: We don't need to talk about that.
Liliweiss flinches and takes a step back.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I won't ever let you go again.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: the most beautiful flower in the world,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: and that's how I want you to remain when I kill you.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: What are you talking about? You'll die too!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You promised! You said you'd take care of the girls!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: So do it! Take care of them!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: You saw for yourself. They've all grown so much.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: They turned out better than I ever could've hoped.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: so you want to die alone when you're no longer yourself?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: And you expect me to just stand there and watch?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Come on. Don't you think that's more than a little cruel?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: There's a reason I've kept going this whole time, living life when there was no joy to it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I thought that maybe, just maybe, a miracle would happen.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: The day where I could see you, hear your voice, touch you,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: and even go away with you.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: this is the happiest ending I can imagine.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I like happy endings. I think they're great.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: How about we go see the ocean?
The tall walls of Dark Matter begin to crumble.
Without its owner, the all-powerful substance disperses.
Two people come walking out from it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: We're only walking out like this because I can't carry Mecha Destructor. It's not a great look for me, but I hope you'll forgive ahhh!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Next time, you'll get worse than a pinch.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Look how you've grown. You've gotten so strong too.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I won't cry or get scared anymore.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: You just go ahead and rest.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'll... send you off... with a smile!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I have but a faint remembrance of one who strove greatly to win.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You've grown so strong. If we fought now, I might lose.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Hmph. Thou needs not speak falsely.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Take care of everything for me, will you?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I'd like to say something to all of you individually too, but unfortunately, we don't have time.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: We have to be off on our honeymoon.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}. Heh, I almost never call you that.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: You know, I've done lots of great things in my life. Too many to count. But one of the best things I've ever done...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... was seeing your potential and fostering it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: You're amazing. You're a great Commander.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: And I'm sure you'll go on to be an even greater, more amazing Commander.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Of course, you won't come anywhere close to achieving what I have, but there's not much you can do about that.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: It's not because of any failing on your part. It's because I'm just that good.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Now, I'm leaving it to you.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: The fate of the world, I mean.
... Thank you. Leave it to me.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: All right, should we get going?
Andersen and Liliweiss look at everyone.
In an instant, they're gone from view.
Everyone silently watches the spot where they disappeared for a long time.
Nikkes from the Ark come running up to us and take care of the wounded.
They look over the Goddess Squad, the Counters, and Crown.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: ... We'll save them, no matter it takes.
Only after they leave do Marian and Nayuta show themselves.
Are you two really all right?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Much has happened, but fret not. 'Tis bearable.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... Hehe. Yes, I'm all right, Commander.
For a while, she silently observes the area around her.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: There's no way to stop it, is there?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: As the only Queen remaining on the surface,

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I must renew the world with the Seven Arbiters.
Marian, I have no idea what you're trying to say, but...
All the Dark Matter spread across the surface reacts.
Marian seizes all the Dark Matter that lost its owner.
Every last bit of it flows toward her.
She's looking at him on the verge of tears.
Am I not going to see you again?
Marian taps her staff on the ground.
There's an explosion of black light,
and an enormous black moon appears before the Commander.
All the Dark Matter gets sucked into the moon.
Nayuta. You know something, don't you?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... must needs renew the world with the Seven Arbiters.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Bound she is to do only that, in a world wholly set apart.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Marian accepted this without reserve.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Methinks the reason for her resolve...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... was to create a world wherein thou canst dwell...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... for she wishes not for thee to die.
And what was that about there being twenty years left? For what? It's something to do with this, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: has less than twenty years of life remaining.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: If naught is done, all will die.
Where is this coming from? The world's going to end in twenty years?
The Commander looks at the black moon.
The ache grows stronger and stronger.
For some reason, the Commander feels like he might cry.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall unfold these things to you,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: but let us first depart from here.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Though Young Lady Marian controls that, its swift growth may prove danger...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Wait. Great Hero. Wherefore dost thou...?!
The Commander runs toward the expanding black moon.
Without hesitation, he throws himself inside.
Marian curls up alone in the black space.
Her mind grows hazy. All sorts of information is filling her head.
The Queen. The Seven Arbiters. Renewing the planet.
All this information fills her mind.
How long do I have to be here?
... Maybe I should've talked with them more before I came.
I wish I'd spent more time talking with them.
No, then it would've been harder to leave. They would've tried to stop me.
Then this world, the one with the Commander, would...
Marian curls up even more tightly.
She's cold. Her heart is cold.
Loneliness is already seeping into her bones.
Marian accepts the feeling that her heart might crumble.
She must send him away quickly.
Not even he can live in this place.
Marian adjusts the flow inside her black moon to push the Commander out.
Marian tries desperately to stop her voice from bursting out of her.
I'll be with you! You don't have to be alone!
No matter how long it takes! I'll be with you!
Marian sees the person she loves most in the world.
The Commander reaches his hand out to Marian.
Marian reaches her hand out to him.
However, an invisible wall keeps them apart.
Marian! Don't do it! Let's get out of here!
There must be a way! I'll find it!
Don't stay here alone! Come with me!
She strokes it, as if trying not to forget the face of the man on the other side of the wall.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll finish this quickly and come back to you.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: And then we'll go on that picnic. I promise.
No... What am I supposed to do... without you...?
The Commander feels the pain in his collarbone again.
On the other side of the invisible wall, Dark Matter gathers on the Commander's hand.
The Commander cradles it in his hands.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Don't you dare forget about me this time. Got it?
Marian backs away from the wall.
She looks at the Commander, tears in her eyes and a smile on her lips.
He desperately clings to his fading consciousness.
The more his consciousness fades, the worse the pain in his collarbone grows.
the Commander's mind is plunged into darkness.
I see a familiar scene and smell a familiar scent.
I sit up in bed and look around me.
I walk, open the door, and go outside.
I see a large number of people, employees and patients alike.
I go to the counter. It's difficult forcing my way through the crowd of people.
I approach someone who seems to be giving information.
She looks equally frazzled from dealing with the swarm of people.
For a while, I stand perfectly still.
I stare at the hospital entrance. People keep pouring in.
The Ark's downtown area looks the same as ever.
the sunlight that is streaming down,
and the wind that ruffles my hair...
The Ark is on the surface.
